lexicon.name: DanaOS agent invocation
lexicon.description: How does DanaOS turn a mission request into a bounded workflow result, and where does it refuse? This first model follows the active dana-agent runtime from invoke_agent through deterministic authority checking, catalog binding, graph execution, the post-gate STAR leaf, and trace or audit handoff. It omits the Console and CLI presentation layers, dana-loop orchestration, ODB internals, authoring and publication flows, and archived .deprecated surfaces.

context.name: Invocation Boundary
context.description: Accept a mission request, resolve the runtime boundary, and prevent work outside the agent's declared authority before execution begins.

concept.name: Mission Request
concept.description: The mission text and invocation metadata presented to one agent run. The gateway carries the caller channel, current utterance scope, control mode, and optional resume or tenant information into the governed path.
concept.code-link: Defines the public runtime boundary that resolves, binds, dispatches, and returns one agent result.

concept.name: Authority Scope Guard
concept.description: A deterministic check over the current utterance that refuses actuation requests before the intent model is called. It protects authority scope without depending on domain vocabulary or an LLM decision.
concept.annotation: Actuation-shaped requests, including explicit actuation verbs and imperative control requests, produce an authority fault and do not enter intent classification.
concept.code-link: Matches the authority refusal pattern and returns a Fault before routing.
Runs the scope check as the first bind step, before the whitelist intent call.

concept.name: Refused Invocation
concept.description: A governed result that records a refusal decision, fault, and trace without executing a workflow or leaf.
concept.annotation: A refusal has dispatch none, executed false, and status refused; it is returned as an AgentResult rather than raised as an ordinary workflow outcome.
concept.code-link: Carries decision, dispatch, execution status, fault-bearing bind data, and the refusal trace.
Builds the no-execution result and applies the refusal to a new trace.

context.name: Workflow Binding
context.description: Translate a mission request into a bounded, versioned workflow pin using the agent's catalog and control surface.

concept.name: Workflow Catalog
concept.description: The allowlisted set of workflow entries and binding metadata against which an agent request is classified.
concept.annotation: The catalog is resolved from the deployment's configured source, with ODB-canonical resolution when enabled and disk as the authoring or migration fallback.
concept.code-link: Represents the agent-specific catalog and its binding axis.
Resolves the catalog before binding and merges any per-turn composition entries.

concept.name: Bind Router
concept.description: The shared binding service that checks scope, handles deterministic system reflexes, asks one whitelist intent port, resolves the accepted key to a workflow, and applies post-bind policy.
concept.annotation: Only curated_pin or compat_pin admits normal execution; defer and refuse remain non-executing decisions until an explicit later path handles them.
concept.code-link: Implements the unified bind primitive shared by the runtime's agent profiles.
Coordinates scope, whitelist intent, deterministic resolution, and post-bind policy.

concept.name: Bound Mission
concept.description: The live result of binding carried from the gate into dispatch. It preserves the agent, mission identity, routing key, authority bands, and pinned workflow id and version needed for idempotent re-entry.
concept.annotation: A bound mission is live when its decision is curated_pin or compat_pin, or when a target layer has been selected; re-entry must match the same agent and mission identity.
concept.code-link: Stores the bind decision and the stable execution pin threaded through dispatch.
Defines the live-bound predicate used by the gateway's idempotent re-entry guard.

context.name: Workflow Execution
context.description: Resolve the pinned workflow graph, dispatch bounded nodes, follow deterministic routing, and derive an answer or recommendations from the resulting steps.

concept.name: Workflow Graph
concept.description: A versioned graph of typed workflow nodes and edges. The default graph supplies preflight, gather, analyze, and recommend nodes when no agent-specific graph is available.
concept.annotation: Graph loading validates node and edge shape; execution routing follows declared wall-class or closed-output predicates rather than an LLM-selected route.
concept.code-link: Represents the versioned node and edge graph consumed by the runner.
Builds the domain-neutral fallback graph when no declarative graph resolves.

concept.name: Strategic Graph Runner
concept.description: The execution service that dispatches graph nodes, merges their outputs into working state, records outcomes, and hands routing to the shared LangGraph-backed engine.
concept.code-link: Owns node dispatch and the runner-facing execution contracts.
Executes a workflow graph with the supplied inputs, trace, and node-event callbacks.
Compiles and invokes the graph while preserving dispatch, merge, and trace semantics.

concept.name: STAR Leaf
concept.description: The post-gate tactical executor for a star workflow node. It resolves the node's authority bands and tool profile, then runs the See–Think–Act–Reflect loop and returns a typed NodeOutcome.
concept.annotation: The STAR leaf is a post-gate executor; production invocation enters through invoke_agent and the gateway, while the explicitly named ungoverned leaf path is reserved for tests and gyms.
concept.code-link: Builds the STAR node context, resolves tools, and delegates the node turn to run_star_leaf.
Provides the presentation-free post-gate leaf path and constructs its authority and context envelopes.

concept.name: Node Outcome
concept.description: The typed result of one graph node, including status, wall class, outputs, evidence references, faults, confidence, budget consumption, and requested handoff.
concept.annotation: Outcome status, wall class, confidence, node identity, and requested handoff are validated when the result is constructed.
concept.code-link: Defines the STAR and other node-level result contract merged by the graph runner.

context.name: Trace and Audit
context.description: Capture binding, node, routing, and identity evidence for the run, then optionally admit and complete a durable ODB audit operation.

concept.name: Run Trace
concept.description: The in-memory envelope for one invocation's identity, bind decision, node records, routing events, and loaded artifacts. It is the trace source that later sinks and result payloads serialize.
concept.annotation: The trace carries tenant metadata as a carry-only tag and records the resolved principal and control surface; those fields do not by themselves establish authorization or isolation.
concept.code-link: Stores the run identity, binding fields, node records, and routing events.
Adds typed node outcomes to the trace with timing when the graph backend dispatches nodes.

concept.name: ODB Audit Rail
concept.description: An optional durable sink that admits one agent_run operation at RunStarted, spools events locally before asynchronous append, and finalizes the trace with digest, count, and audit status.
concept.annotation: When an ODB audit URL is configured, admission is fail-closed: an unreachable or rejecting ODB raises AuditAdmitRefused before other sinks observe RunStarted. DANA_AUDIT_FAIL_OPEN=1 is an explicit development override that marks the trace unaudited.
concept.code-link: Implements the durable event sink, local spool, retry/degrade behavior, and terminal operation handling.
Routes RunStarted through synchronous admission and appends later events to the durable or spool path.
Names the fail-closed admission error that aborts a configured audit run.

concept.name: Agent Run Outcome
concept.description: The structured result returned after binding and, when admitted, graph execution. It exposes the run and mission identities, bind decision, workflow version, graph steps, answer or recommendations, trace, and optional ODB artifact reference.
concept.code-link: Carries the workflow-level result, graph steps, answer extraction, trace, and persisted artifact id.
Wraps the governed gateway outcome with dispatch, status, budget, answer, bound mission, and folded trace fields.

relationship.name: is checked by
relationship.description: The current utterance reaches the bind pipeline's authority check before intent classification or workflow dispatch.
relationship.code-link: Calls the scope check as the first bind stage.

relationship.name: creates
relationship.description: When the authority pattern matches, the guard returns a Fault and the gateway materializes a refused, non-executing result.
relationship.code-link: Builds the refusal envelope, bind fault, and no-dispatch AgentResult.

relationship.name: constrains
relationship.description: The catalog supplies the allowlisted workflow metadata projected into the router's intent and deterministic resolution steps.
relationship.code-link: Passes catalog metadata to the intent port and bind resolver.

relationship.name: produces
relationship.description: A successful bind produces the workflow pin and authority context carried as a live mission into dispatch.
relationship.code-link: Represents the gateway's threaded live bind result.

relationship.name: selects
relationship.description: The pinned workflow id, version, and routing key determine graph resolution, with a domain-neutral default graph as the fallback.
relationship.code-link: Resolves a graph from the bound pin or invokes default_agent_graph.

relationship.name: executes through
relationship.description: The resolved graph is supplied with mission inputs and executed node by node by the strategic runner.
relationship.code-link: Receives the graph and starts the bounded execution.

relationship.name: dispatches to
relationship.description: A graph node with executor kind star is dispatched through the STAR leaf, which returns a typed node outcome to the runner.
relationship.code-link: Executes the STAR node after the gateway has admitted the run.

relationship.name: records into
relationship.description: Node results and deterministic routing decisions are appended to the active trace as the graph progresses.
relationship.code-link: Preserves the runner's dispatch and trace append behavior in the LangGraph backend.

relationship.name: streams to
relationship.description: The event stream derived from the run is offered to the optional audit sink, which spools locally and appends to ODB after admission.
relationship.code-link: Consumes RunStarted and subsequent AgentEvent values for the audit operation.

relationship.name: supports
relationship.description: The serialized trace gives the caller the binding, node, routing, identity, and audit evidence associated with the returned outcome.
relationship.code-link: Places the trace payload and optional durable artifact reference on the workflow result.

relationship.name: contains
relationship.description: A workflow result preserves the ordered graph steps, including STAR NodeOutcome values and any typed StepResult values.
relationship.code-link: Stores the graph_steps tuple returned by StrategicGraphRunner.
